info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Banking Facilities Property Portfolios-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking Facilities Property Portfolios API provides access to a comprehensive list of available property portfolios associated with banking facilities. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information on various property portfolios that can be leveraged for banking operations. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions, property management systems, and real estate analysts looking to assess the offerings of banking facilities. By utilizing this API, users can enhance their decision-making processes related to property investments and portfolio management.

get.summary: Retrieve the property portfolio of facilities.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the complete list of properties in the facility portfolio. It provides detailed information about each property, enabling effective management and analysis of all properties under the facility operations.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the property portfolio data.
